module: CENSUS-2B / V-ULT-1 -- the U-VHT data module
class: substrate + Tier-E first-look; NO REGISTRATIONS; m = 0

pins.warm_bars_rule: ceil(3.46*N), NaN before warm, never backfilled
pins.machinery_note: scripts/census_build.py constants + _resample imported, not restated; census2a_program.py byte-untouched
pins.klines_note: LIVE cache (engine.data.cache_dir), NOT mc1/ops_klines -- census-2B spans the full history and reports evidence-era share as a column

parta_wtb1.horizon_rule: DURATION-fixed: H20 = 20x5m = 1h40m, H100 = 100x5m = 8h20m; bars = round(hms/TF_MS[tf]); bars<1 is INFEASIBLE -> NaN, never substituted
parta_wtb1.toll_note: measured on each table's OWN event population, per census2a_program.py:1226-1234 note m8
parta_wtb1.class: Tier-E substrate + Tier-E descriptive; NO REGISTRATIONS; W-B's motif surface m is declared in the probe ledger
